notes:
Venture 0.22 — compass calibration finishes on screen, a steady Remote ID readout, and a tidier mission overview

• A compass calibration no longer sits at 99% for ever. The aircraft had finished — 99 is the moment its sample buffer fills, and it fits within a fraction of a second — but its result was arriving one byte shorter than the controller would accept whenever the aircraft had no GPS fix, so the screen never moved on. The result now lands the moment the aircraft has it, and the screen goes straight to the fit. Expect to see a poor fitness for the first time on calibrations done indoors: that number was always there, it was just never shown.

• The RID readout on the flight screen no longer flickers between OK and Glitch once a second. An aircraft with a second module on the CAN bus that also speaks Remote ID sends two opinions a second, and the controller was showing each in turn. It now holds OK while the transmitter is still saying so. The aircraft itself still hears both, so if arming is refused with an empty Remote ID reason, that second module is the cause and wants finding.

• LAND on the flight bar is yellow, in the same style as RTL. It takes RTL's place once the aircraft is returning, so it now looks like the next step of coming home rather than a different kind of button.

• The mission overview's top strip has the name centred on the screen, and the controller's Wi-Fi, battery and clock sit at the right edge where they are on every other screen. They used to shift with the length of the name.

• The Lane Spacing step no longer prints "Camera estimated — aircraft has not reported its lens" under every plan. It appeared whether or not anything was wrong. The warning for an unrecognised lens remains.

Installing over the top keeps your missions and settings. Units running 0.21-dev take this update like any other.
